content: This paper has investigated the end-to-end method for ST. It has discussed why there is a huge gap between pre-training and fine-tuning in previous methods. To alleviate these issues, we have proposed a method, which is capable of reusing every sub-net and keeping the role of sub-net consistent between pre-training and fine-tuning. Empirical studies have demonstrated that our model significantly outperforms baselines.
